training: Official state BC, corrected replay data, seed 1, 100000 updates, checkpoint/validation every 10000 updates; fresh run because original preprocessing was defective
success: Ignore terminations; report success_once and success_at_end at fixed horizon, plus success_once at 100 steps
selection: Maximum validation success_once; tie: maximum success_at_end; tie: earliest checkpoint
credible_target: At least 80% validation and test success_once, at least 70% success_at_end
fallback: If BC validation remains below target, run official Diffusion Policy on the same data and validation seeds before selecting the final model
test_rule: Select model and checkpoint using validation only; one final evaluation on the untouched test seeds
